name: napkin
description: A Codex-native burn-rate and runway calculator with an editable spreadsheet.

interface.shortDescription: Model burn rate and runway in an editable sheet.
interface.longDescription: Napkin gives Codex a thread-scoped burn-rate calculator it can open in the in-app browser and read through MCP. It keeps monthly cash assumptions visible, treats user edits as the source of truth, and asks before changing edited cells.
defaultPrompt: Model my burn rate in a sheet.
Update the runway after my edits.
